question: In a certain code language, if COMPUTER is coded as 'DPNQVUFS' and KEYBOARD is coded as 'LFZCPBSE,' then what will MOUSE be coded as?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c862ea9c33a633c54bfcf4c329c66d9a52118504f28cbfbfdf760e12f52cc05.png] 

The logic followed here is:

COMPUTER is coded as 'DPNQVUFS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82b5edef9902cd6f4d95dd06da152e1bf9462076f1c30a640324315645d447e9.png] 

KEYBOARD is coded as 'LFZCPBSE,'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2c74e9cec3868ca0c3295fc275e1b6fc2a6103d6f145a0d1522ab38dc7d66f7.png] 

Similarly, MOUSE will be coded:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6281071f38ebe77042971cd2cacf301d9db6efc486a21dbd2741723b3ae8484c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"NPVTF".**
